scene.title: Sine and Cosine on the Unit Circle
scene.summary: The x‑coordinate of a point on the unit circle is cos θ and the y‑coordinate is sin θ.

beats.title: Draw the unit circle
beats.narration: A circle of radius 1 centered at the origin is the unit circle.

beats.title: Pick an angle
beats.narration: Choose θ = 60°. The point on the circle is P(0.5, 0.866).

beats.title: Show the coordinates
beats.narration: The horizontal side equals the x‑coordinate (cos θ) and the vertical side equals the y‑coordinate (sin θ).

beats.title: Reveal the answer
beats.narration: The vertical segment is sin θ, while the horizontal segment is cos θ.

beats.title: Recap
beats.narration: On the unit circle, the x‑coordinate of a point is cos θ and the y‑coordinate is sin θ.
